title: デビュー戦の後に・バクシンスタート！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After a successful debut race, Sakura Bakushin O is full of confidence. Following that high, she's all hyped up to run in G1 races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But with no real victories under her belt, running a G1 race would be near impossible! Wanting to assess her short distance skills, I suggest the Keio Hai Junior Stakes instead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Bakushin O seems reluctant, but I argue that having the spectators gradually come around to witnessing her speed would be good. Fully won over, her motivation does a one-eighty.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Bakushin O's next goal is now the Keio Hai Junior Stakes.
